root_cause: The original FTS search opened its disposable SQLite cache without recovery and indexed otherwise eligible text without a content secret-pattern check. A corrupt cache aborted the CLI, and a fixture token introduced into an eligible source could enter the cache and results.
fix_summary: Rebuild the cache once after SQLite errors, then fall back to bounded safe source retrieval. Exclude secret-pattern content before indexing and evict an older cache when a newly unsafe source is detected. Synthetic tests use generated fake values only; no production credential exposure is claimed.
